los ajustes del piloto del GPS: activarl: the GPS autopilot settings: turn it on or off and choose how it drives: Automatic, Calm, Normal obeying the rules, Hurried but obeying the rules, Hurried breaking the rules, or Super hurried, at full speed
A toda la velocidad que da el vehículo y: At the vehicle's full top speed, without waiting at traffic lights. With so little room to brake, it crashes more often. If the police see you, fines and license points.
Al noventa por ciento de lo que da el ve: At ninety percent of the vehicle's top speed, without waiting at traffic lights. If the police see you, it will cost you fines and license points.
Automático corre solo cuando hace falta;: Automatic only hurries when needed; Calm drives slowly; Normal always obeys the rules; Hurried but obeying the rules floors it without getting ticketed; Hurried, breaking the rules goes at ninety percent of the vehicle's top speed and doesn't wait at traffic lights; and Super hurried goes at full speed. You can also choose it at the wheel with a quick tap of A.
